exposure: maternal exposure to antibiotics during pregnancy
outcome: Relative abundance of specific bacteria (e.g., Bifidobacterium, Clostridium perfringens)
cohort: 1023 one-month-old infants from the KOALA Birth Cohort
finding: Breastfeeding and antibiotic exposure were associated with contrasting shifts in infant gut microbiota composition, while specific HMOs (6'-SL, LNH) and GOS-supplemented formula were associated with the relative abundances of certain bacteria.
mod_finding: This study found that Cesarean section delivery was associated with alterations in infant gut microbiota composition.
